notes.title: Announcing Classic mode DLC and Dedicated Server
notes.content:
[h1]What is Classic mode[/h1]
Classic mode will be a collection of mods which were in the original mobile release. These include: Multipliers, Incrementors, Incrementor Incrementors, discount modules, and finally eventually lock modules.

[h1]Will Classic mode get updates[/h1]
I plan to release patches if needed and 1 update which will include the lock mod, as that has been especially difficult to implement.

[h1]What are the benefits of dedicated server?[/h1]
Dedicated server will eventually be able to save player progress allowing them to login later and contunue where they left off.

[h1]and finally WHEN IS 4.0.0 COMING OUT???[/h1]
4.0.0 will be released at 11:00 am EST the 28th, for the first half hour after release i will be streaming multiplayer on the discord which you can join with this [url=http://discord.com/invite/vrVVXktmfV]invite[/url].

notes.title: What Ever Happened To IP?
notes.content:
[h2]Quick Summary: nothing[/h2]
The past few months have seen little to no information regarding Infinite progression, but that is for a reason. There are a few features listed below that I am ecstatic to announce for version 4.0.0 coming late March.
[h2]Multiplayer[/h2]
Now you can play IP with your friends or even random people. This will have multiple gameplay modes including timed mode, where you must progress as far as you can to win. There will also be a First To mode, where you have to race to get to a mod count as fast as you can.
[h2]Added a Tutorial[/h2]
You can now learn to play the game. Yes, this wasn’t there before.
[h2]A More Robust Scoring System[/h2]
I have also been working behind the scenes to improve the system in which you unlock new modules. Now mods can act like sliders and disable the buy-next button.
[h2]A Better Community Workshop System[/h2]
This kind of goes without saying as I have stated it before, but you will be able to upload mods to the workshop.
[h2]Classic Mode DLC[/h2]
This will be a free DLC essentially containing the base mods. It will just be a better way of obtaining the base mods.
[h2]And A Lot More[/h2]

notes.title: Join the beta for the upcoming HUGE 4.0.0 Update
notes.content:
I am now opening a beta for the 4.0.0 update to the public, this update will mostly be bug patches, but will also include a full tutorial and a tool tip system for mods. Along with this you will also now be able to upload to the workshop again as I have finally tested and improved the upload code.

To join the beta, go into game properties > betas and enter the password "LetsGoGetTheBeta"

notes.title: 3.0.0 - Initial Steam Release
notes.content:
I just want to start off by thanking everyone who has kept me on track for this monuments release, without you this game would still probably still be an itch exclusive, with no level editor and so on.

While this is the initial release, I will still be working on IP non-stop to implement a better help system as the major downfall to IP is currently the rough learning curve for both modding and game play.
